description: Send email as the firm's own address. `to`/`subject`/`body` for one message, `messages` for many with different content each. `to` takes ONE address. Check failed_count — a partial send returns 200.

from.description: Which configured sender it comes from, e.g. 'billing@theirshop.com'. Omit for the firm's default sender.

to.description: ONE recipient address. For several people use `messages`.

cc.description: Addresses that should see each other on this one message.

messages.description: Many messages in one call, each {to, subject, body}. One connection, one set of results.

items.description: A message object: {to, subject, body, cc?}.
